sentence: This project builds a way to make polymer nanoparticles using chemical vapor deposition, with artificial intelligence helping choose the processing conditions.
This project builds a partnership that studies course sequences in computer science and cybersecurity, and collects data to understand regional labor market needs.
This project measures how soft materials such as silicones and rubbers deform inside and uses artificial intelligence to build computer models of them.
This project builds technologies that let a robot handle unfamiliar objects for difficult tasks, based on the shapes and materials of the objects.
This project combines citizen science with machine learning to better classify the shapes of events recorded by a neutrino telescope.
This project builds quantum computing hardware and software that use light, including light sources, detectors and processing units on a single chip.
This project builds a community that will make a map of where molecules are and what they do inside plant cells and tissues.
This project uses simulation to study how attacks on connected and automated vehicles work and how to defend against them.
This project builds a way to compress, stream and recover 360 degree video so that computers can analyze it live despite limited network bandwidth.
This project studies how quantum computers can be attacked and builds defenses against attacks that use timing, power and other side channels.
This project develops a cybersecurity curriculum and adds hands-on learning and an AI-assisted Research Buddy.
This project studies how the human brain decides whether a surprising outcome reflects a real change or just random noise, and whether this takes effort.
This project builds a swarm of aerial and ground robots that search large unknown areas for targets and keep working despite sensor failures and attacks.
This project studies how differences in the number of copies of ribosomal RNA genes affect development, tumor formation and lifespan in an animal.
This project studies how water moves beneath glaciers and ice sheets, and improves computer models of it to better predict sea-level change.
